defect_1_mita_missing_composition.root_cause: The safety surrogate model 'mche_minimum_approach_mita' was trained without N2, C2, C2H4, and C3 features. It only sees C1 (methane). 80%+ of its correlation signal comes from ambient temperature (t_amb_c = -0.7986), which is an unmanipulated environmental disturbance. Furthermore, the monotonic constraints [-1, 1, 0, 0] force signs directly opposite to the empirical DoE correlations (+0.0256 and -0.0052). The surrogate cannot evaluate pinch changes resulting from adjusting C2, C3, or N2.
defect_1_mita_missing_composition.action: REJECT surrogate model; require rigorous 100-slice PR-EOS pinch evaluation.

defect_2_fixed_mita_7_169.physical_impossibility: In a multi-stream LNG cryogenic heat exchanger (MCHE), pinch temperature approach is fundamentally load-dependent. Throughput changes from 140 t/h (P10) to 306 t/h (P90), shifting the hot composite curve (feed gas condensing + HP MCR condensing/subcooling) and cold composite curve (LP MCR boiling). Having mean_mita == min_mita == 7.169 °C with zero variance across all 100 quantiles proves that MITA was not calculated as an optimization result across the load points, but was hardcoded/broadcast as a static constant through the reporting layer.
defect_2_fixed_mita_7_169.action: REJECT static 7.169 °C claim; compute load-dependent MITA(q) from 100-slice enthalpy curves.

Line 11: - total_compressor_power_steam_MW: Ground-truth via verified 4.04 t/MWh steam rate
Line 48: STEAM_RATE_T_PER_MWH = 4.04      # verified condensate-meter anchor (R2 = 0.9989)
Line 102: out["total_compressor_power_steam_MW"] = out["total_steam_t_h"] / STEAM_RATE_T_PER_MWH
Line 105: (out["total_compressor_power_steam_MW"] * 1000.0) / out["LNG_mass_flow_t_h"],
Line 415: "total_compressor_power_steam_MW", "SEC_steam_kWh_per_t_LNG",
defect_3_steam_power_circularity.tautology_explanation: In 08_enrich_physics_features.py, shaft_power_total_c3mr_mw was constructed as: total_compressor_power_steam_MW = total_steam_t_h / 4.04. Then, the surrogate driver_steam_demand was trained to predict total_steam_t_h using shaft_power_total_c3mr_mw. The model achieved R2 = 0.9997 with correlation = 0.9999 solely because it learned the exact algebraic identity: steam = power * 4.04. DCS telemetry contains NO shaft torquemeter data. Validating the model against this column merely recovers the fixed factor 4.04.
defect_3_steam_power_circularity.action: REJECT steam/4.040 power definition; use OEM curve-derived shaft work from suction/discharge P, T, and flow.
